listing.name: Earthworm Jim HD — Earthworm Jim HD PC port (devEx780)
listing.summary: Earthworm Jim HD port using your Xbox 360 files. Upstream reports working saves, local multiplayer and all 16 levels; a complete campaign and boss playthrough have not been confirmed. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Earthworm Jim HD Xbox 360 XBLA package or its complete extracted files. Title 584109E2/v1.0.0.11.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract the Windows ZIP or Linux archive, place your own files in game, then follow upstream instructions for play.cmd or run.sh.

warnings: Upstream reports working saves, local multiplayer and all 16 levels. A complete campaign and boss playthrough have not been confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
